title: Match Service Models
description: Classify well-known apps into IaaS, PaaS, or SaaS.
problemStatement:
Given the following list of services, classify each as **IaaS**, **PaaS**, or **SaaS**. Write your answer as a list:

- Amazon EC2
- Gmail
- Heroku
- AWS Elastic Beanstalk
- Salesforce
- Google Compute Engine

Explain the reasoning for at least two of your choices.
hints: IaaS gives you raw virtual machines – you manage the OS.
PaaS handles the OS for you; you only bring code.
SaaS is a finished application you simply use.
expectedOutput: A list with correct classifications and brief explanations for at least two items.
solutionCode:
Amazon EC2 -> IaaS (you control the OS and software)
Gmail -> SaaS (fully managed email service)
Heroku -> PaaS (you deploy code, Heroku runs it)
AWS Elastic Beanstalk -> PaaS (manage app only)
Salesforce -> SaaS (complete CRM application)
Google Compute Engine -> IaaS (raw virtual machines)

Explanation examples:
- EC2 is IaaS because you get a virtual server and must install and maintain the OS.
- Gmail is SaaS because you just log in and use email without worrying about servers or maintenance.
